probes.What is a toothbrush?:
A toothbrush is a small hand-held brush used to clean teeth and gums. It typically consists of a handle and a head with bristles that are used to scrub the teeth. Toothbrushes are an essential tool for maintaining good oral hygiene and preventing dental problems such as tooth decay and gum disease.

The bristles of a toothbrush are usually made from nylon or other synthetic materials and are arranged in a specific pattern to effectively clean the teeth. The handle is designed to provide a comfortable grip for the user.

Toothbrushes come in various sizes, shapes, and designs, including manual and electric

probes.What are human teeth made of?:
Human teeth are made of several different types of hard tissues. The main components are enamel dentin and cementum.

Enamel is the hardest and most highly mineralized substance in the human body. It is the outermost layer of the crown of the tooth which is the part of the tooth visible above the gum line. Enamel is primarily composed of a mineral called hydroxyapatite which is a form of calcium phosphate. This mineral gives enamel its strength and ability to resist wear from chewing. Enamel does not contain living cells and it cannot repair itself if damaged.
